notes.title: Derora AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
[h1] Derora has hatched! [/h1]

We are really excited to announce [b] Derora [/b] is now available!

You can also get a bonus [b] 10% discount [/b] for a limited time only. 

Visit the [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/700540/Derora/]STORE PAGE[/url] to purchase now.

We can't wait to hear what you think about the games development so far and your thoughts for further development!

We want this to become a game shaped by its players so please do post any development ideas on our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/700540/discussions/] Community Hub[/url] 

We have lots of our own plans too and will be releasing a full development roadmap in due course but to give you a taster, we definitely want to add;

- Multiplayer
- Adjustable difficulty levels
- Endless Challenge Mode
- More levels (Charting Derora's journey to back to the nest)
- More Block / Spore variations 

Happy climbing! 

Thanks

[b] Derora Devs [/b]

🐣
